versions.changelog: Description tail link + agents machine-readable metadata line (deciqai.com/s/mortgage-rate-negotiation-anchoring.json)

- Initial release of the mortgage-rate-negotiation-anchoring skill.
- Activates when borrowers reference teaser rates, present APR/points trade-offs, or competitor lowball quotes.
- Provides guidance on honest re-anchoring: focus on apples-to-apples comparisons using APR and total cost, normalizing for points and lock periods.
- Includes compliance reminders (truthful advertising, fair-lending, and LO comp rules).
- Offers actionable resources: comparison sheets and competitor quote guides.
- Highlights red flags such as bait-and-switch tactics and non-normalized rate comparisons.
